title: Magic Knight Rayearth 2026 Unveils New Trailer Featuring Theme Songs, Additional Cast
content: The upcoming Magic Knight Rayearth anime remake unveiled a new trailer that features the opening and ending theme songs and four additional cast members. Toaka performs the opening theme song “Otome no Ken” and the ending theme song “Seira” is performed by Yurina Kawaguchi.
author: Anime Corner

title: New 'Magic Knight Rayearth' Unveils Additional Cast, Theme Songs, Second Promo
content: The stage event for the new television anime adaptation of CLAMP 's Magic Knight Rayearth at the Kyoto International Manga Anime Fair 2026 unveiled additional cast, the theme songs, and a second promotional video on Sunday. The new anime series is scheduled to premiere on October 7 at 11.45 p.m.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Roshidere Season 2 Reveals Teaser Trailer
content: Alya Sometimes Hides Her Feelings in Russian (Roshidere) Season 2 revealed a teaser trailer on Sunday. The sequel is slated to premiere in 2027 . Doga Kobo returns to animate the second season with a new director, Hiroshi Haraguchi, replacing Ryota Itoh.
author: Anime Corner

title: Alya Sometimes Hides Her Feelings in Russian TV Anime's 2nd Season Reveals Teaser Video
content: Kadokawa unveiled a new teaser video at the KyoMAF event on Sunday for the second anime season of writer Sunsunsun and artist Momoco 's Alya Sometimes Hides Her Feelings in Russian ( Tokidoki Bosotto Russia-go de Dereru Tonari no Alya-san ) light novel series.
author: ANN

title: 10 Years Later, This Is Still One of Anime’s Most Heartbreaking Movies Ever
content: The ever-growing popularity of the anime industry in recent years has many curious people looking to venture into the world of exciting shows and movies. While the anime medium has been popular in the U.S. since the 1990s, it continues to grow even now.
author: ComicBook

title: Shonen Jump Hit Confirms Crunchyroll Return Date for New Season After Finale – Watch Trailer
content: The Fall 2026 anime season is right around the corner, and it’s going to be the biggest quarter of this year. 2026 has been a considerably exciting year for fans with the return of many major shows, including Jujutsu Kaisen, Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End , and more.
author: ComicBook

title: 10 Things I Want to Do Before I Turn 40 Boys-Love Manga Also Gets Live-Action Film
content: The staff for the live-action series of Mamita 's 10 Things I Want to Do Before I Turn 40 ( 40 Made ni Shitai 10 no Koto ) boys-love manga announced on Saturday that the manga is also receving a live-action film on January 22, 2027. The cast of the TV series are reprising their roles for the film.
author: ANN

title: Winners of Next Manga Award 2026 Announced
content: The winners of Kadokawa 's annual Next Manga Award were announced on Wednesday. The awards ceremony was streamed on Niconico on the same day. Out of the 7,952 titles that were submitted for the award, 100 titles (40 print manga, 60 web manga) were nominated by a special commitee for the final round of voting.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Dragon Ball Super Fans Bring Black Frieza to Life Ahead of the Villain’s Anime Return – Watch Now
content: Dragon Ball Super is currently in the works on coming back with a new anime picking up with the missing arcs of the manga, but a special fan animation has brought Black Frieza to life as they are looking forward to seeing this moment hit the official anime release.
author: ComicBook
